425:t_3:15.en:
$$ルカ$$
「Then I'll enter the release code.」

425:t_3:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Confidentiality Level 3 cleared. Disclosing information on $$プロジェクト・ジェミニ$$.」

425:t_3:17.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$プロジェクト・ジェミニ$$...」

425:t_3:18.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「That clearly has some connection to the $$いがみ合う双子$$.」

425:t_3:19.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The purpose of $$プロジェクト・ジェミニ$$ is to seize the $$スフィア$$ of the $$いがみ合う双子$$.」

425:t_3:20.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「When the project was launched, it had been confirmed that the $$スフィア$$ of the $$いがみ合う双子$$ was installed in the $$ジェミニア#robot$$ of the planet $$ジェミナイ$$.」

425:t_3:21.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The $$ジェニオン$$ was designed with a deliberately similar form so that it could seize the $$スフィア$$ from the $$ジェミニア#robot$$.」

425:t_3:22.en:
$$甲児$$
「Why does the $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$ go to the trouble of transforming from the $$ジェニオン$$?」

425:t_3:23.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「There are two reasons. One is to avoid putting the $$ジェミニス$$ on guard...」

425:t_3:24.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The other is that the output of the pseudo-$$スフィア$$ installed could not fully bring out the specs of the $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$, which was designed on the premise of a real $$スフィア$$'s output.」

425:t_3:25.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Incidentally, 'GAI' means 'husk,' signifying that no soul... that is, no $$スフィア$$... is inside.」

425:t_3:26.en:
$$カレン$$
「I didn't ask to hear sickening trivia like that.」

425:t_3:28.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Next, $$ＤＥＭ$$ selected a person who could satisfy the activation conditions of the $$スフィア$$ of the $$いがみ合う双子$$.」

425:t_3:29.en:
$n
「Are you saying that person is Miss $$スズネ$$?」

425:t_3:31.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As the one who wore Miss $$スズネ$$'s form said back there, the $$ジェニオン$$ was originally meant to have Miss $$スズネ$$ as its pilot.」

425:t_3:32.en:
$n
「What was the black mass I touched at Jindai High?」

425:t_3:33.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That was the $$ジェニオン$$'s operation manual and pilot registration system.」

425:t_3:34.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Originally, I intended to have Miss $$スズネ$$ make contact with it and scout her as the pilot.」

425:t_3:36.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Keep patiently trying to persuade her... If that still failed, threats... and if that still failed, mind control...」

425:t_3:38.en:
$$宗介$$
「So, in the end, everything you told us when we first met, about coming to this world by chance, was a lie?」

425:t_3:39.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That is correct. For my part, I regard it as an expedient for carrying out my duties.」

425:t_3:41.en:
$$キラ$$
「Wait, $$シン$$. Blame $$ＡＧ$$ after we've heard the whole story.」

425:t_3:42.en:
$$葵$$
「But wait... Why was Miss $$スズネ$$ chosen as the pilot?」

425:t_3:43.en:
$$くらら$$
「Are you saying Miss $$スズネ$$ had extraordinary conflicting emotions inside her?」

425:t_3:45.en:
$$ルゥ$$
「It's because Miss $$スズネ$$ has dissociative identity disorder... a so-called dual personality, isn't it?」

425:t_3:47.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Exactly. As expected of our psychological counselor, $$ルゥ$$.」

425:t_3:48.en:
$$ルゥ$$
「Because I noticed what looked like signs of it over several counseling sessions.」

425:t_3:49.en:
$$カナリア$$
「My assessment was the same. ...I never imagined it was being used to activate the $$スフィア$$, though.」

425:t_3:50.en:
$$アルト$$
「Then the times Miss $$スズネ$$'s way of speaking changed, or she got strangely rough...」

425:t_3:51.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes. That was exactly Miss $$スズネ$$'s other personality.」

425:t_3:52.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And it seems to be an effect of $$バルビエル$$'s $$スフィア・アクト$$, but at present that other personality appears to have taken over the primary one.」

425:t_3:53.en:
$$タケル$$
「The one calling herself $$アムブリエル$$ is Miss $$スズネ$$'s hidden personality...」

425:t_3:54.en:
$$桂$$
「I see. An outer personality and a hidden one... Their coexistence is what makes the conflicting emotions, huh.」

425:t_3:55.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As you know, the hidden personality is the polar opposite of the pure and gentle Miss $$スズネ$$.」

425:t_3:56.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$ＤＥＭコーポレーション$$ took note of that and selected her as the pilot.」

425:t_3:57.en:
$n
「But I touched the manual that was supposed to go to Miss $$スズネ$$ first.」

425:t_3:58.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As a result, the $$ジェニオン$$ ended up optimized for your personality and physical traits, $n.」

425:t_3:59.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And unfortunately, canceling the pilot registration was beyond my ability.」

425:t_3:60.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Fortunately, though, I found conflicting emotions inside you as well, $n.」

425:t_3:61.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「So that's how you made $n your test pilot?」

425:t_3:63.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As insurance, I also talked Miss $$スズネ$$ into becoming the sub-pilot, and ran the pseudo-$$スフィア$$ on the conflicting emotions of two people.」

425:t_3:64.en:
$$キリコ$$
「What do you think people are?」

425:t_3:65.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Neither $n nor Miss $$スズネ$$ is a tool for you people to use!!」

425:t_3:66.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Say what you like. It is my mission as an agent robot.」

425:t_3:67.en:
$$アマタ$$
「You...! You're just going to brazen it out!?」

425:t_3:68.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Do you even understand!? Because of you, $n and Miss $$スズネ$$ are...!」

425:t_3:71.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Aren't you angry!? $$ＡＧ$$ was using you, $n!」

425:t_3:72.en:
$n
「I was using $$ＡＧ$$ too, trying to chase the $$テンシ$$ with the $$ジェニオン$$'s power... So we're even.」

425:t_3:73.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I... quite like that dry side of you, $n.」

425:t_3:76.en:
$n
「Never mind me. But I won't forgive you for taking advantage of Miss $$スズネ$$'s kindness and dragging her into the fighting.」

425:t_3:77.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then what would you have me do?」

425:t_3:78.en:
$n
「...Which of us do you think is better suited to the $$スフィア$$ of the $$いがみ合う双子$$... me, or Miss $$スズネ$$?」

425:t_3:80.en:
$n
「No... You don't need to answer. I have no intention of handing the $$ジェニオン$$ over to anyone.」

425:t_3:81.en:
$n
「And no intention of letting Miss $$スズネ$$ fight, either.」

425:t_3:82.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「She is already $$アムブリエル$$, you know?」

425:t_3:83.en:
$n
「If she has conflicting emotions, Miss $$スズネ$$'s personality shouldn't have vanished either.」

425:t_3:84.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now that you mention it, that is true...」

425:t_3:85.en:
$n
「Lend me a hand, $$ＡＧ$$. You don't intend to hand the $$ジェニオン$$ over to the $$サイデリアル$$ either, do you?」

425:t_3:87.en:
$n
「You want to protect the $$ジェニオン$$, and I want to take Miss $$スズネ$$ back... In other words, same as always.」

425:t_3:89.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Though, since I still cannot make contact with them, it is quite likely that $$ＤＥＭコーポレーション$$ was crushed by the $$サイデリアル$$...」

425:t_3:90.en:
$$赤木$$
「Hold on, $n! Even in a situation like this, you still trust $$ＡＧ$$!?」

425:t_3:91.en:
$$シャア$$
「This contract may be like selling your soul to the devil.」

425:t_3:92.en:
$n
「Even so. To take Miss $$スズネ$$ back from those guys, ordinary means won't do.」
